name: Google Refresh Outdated Content tool

search.notes: Use after a site has removed a listing but Google still shows the old title or snippet.

steps: Confirm the listing page is gone or changed on the source site.
Sign in with any Google Account and open the Refresh Outdated Content tool.
Paste the exact URL of the old result and submit a refresh request.
Check the request status on the same page.
optout.notes: Only works when the source page is already removed or changed. It does not remove live pages.

verification_note: Help page loaded on 2026-10-27 and links to the tool. The tool URL redirects to Google sign-in.
